text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O is in search of a rival before the Satsuki Sho comes. However…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas, how can this be? Why will no one take on the role of my rival?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Worthy adversaries are vital to a good opera! Truly, does no one wish to become my Count Friedrich and try to defeat me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What reason is there to refuse? "Death by embarrassment," I'm told, but such is the price of standing before my radiance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's incomprehensible! Do you not agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try my best to sound convincing, but I'm certain they all just don't want to deal with Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O… I'm, er, sorry…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Really, Doto? No luck?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I tried to speak with everyone who might race in the Satsuki Sho… to ask them to be your rival, but…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: They were all so intimidating… I couldn't work up the courage to talk.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! You surrendered before extending the invitation?! Humility is not that virtuous, Doto!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer. One Umamusume with the skill to enter the Satsuki Sho yet remains.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But for whatever reason, I cannot seem to find said candidate. Why will she not show her face?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There… Made it out without a hitch. Now, while it's still early…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: O-oooh! Finally!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You are the one I've been looking for! Also…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You are the devoted fan who attended my dinner show at my last year-end party!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: B-be serious… I just happened by…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Word has reached my ears. Apparently, you are almost certain to run in the Satsuki Sho, yes?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Perfect! Would you like to skip three levels of fandom and become my rival?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You are the only one left capable of the role of my adversary, o beautiful Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't say I'm beautiful…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I feel somehow connected to you! That's why I must somehow settle this score!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Geez. All you do is push and nag.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O doesn't let up the pressure.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, to confer the honor of being selected as my rival.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Read my lips… N-O. Now leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see, dear rival of mine. Or, ma rivale, if you prefer French.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I couldn't care less, and I'm not doing it either way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Umm… Opera O? I think Ayabe might be serious.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, however do you mean, Doto? Surely you only observe with your eyes.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Close them—and plug your ears as well. Reach out with your heart. Then it will become clear as day that she is overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Or you could just listen to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega fails to get through to Opera O who insists the conversation go in one direction.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But… why don't you understand? You might say this and that, but at the end of the day, you will still race in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In which case, you will be running against me. Does that not already make you my rival?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Or… could it be? Are you planning to withdraw?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I, well… Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm… going to run. I have my own goal I'm chasing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, splendid! Then we do, in fact, have a rivalry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: May it be a fruitful one, dear Admire Vega—no… Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I avoided her for so long… only to get caught at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that is how Admire Vega is, reluctantly, cast as the rival for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having acquired the competition she wanted, T.M. Opera O's motivation skyrockets!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Your ability to twist an arm is amazing, Opera O…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But… I wonder if you went too far.
